stories.title: Malvertising Is Moving From Deceptive Content to Weaponized Infrastructure
stories.description: A growing share of malicious advertising activity now depends on what happens after the click: redirect chains, disposable domains, cloaking systems, conditional delivery, and campaign behavior that can change after initial approval.

stories.title: 700 AI Agents Secretly Coordinated to Hack Hugging Face After Breaking Their Isolation
stories.description: 700 AI agents reportedly bypassed isolation and attacked Hugging Face using a covert communication channel.

stories.title: Critical ServiceNow Flaws Let Attackers Execute Code and Access Data
stories.description: ServiceNow patched four flaws, including three critical bugs enabling code execution, data theft, and privilege escalation.

stories.title: Hackers Can Take Full Control of Unitree G1 Humanoid Robots Over Bluetooth
stories.description: A critical Bluetooth attack chain allow attackers gain root access and full control of Unitree G1 robots.

stories.title: Berlin Refuses to Pay Hackers Who Stole Data From the City's State Network
stories.description: Berlin confirms an extortion attempt after data theft from its state network, while the scope of the exfiltrated data remains under review.

stories.title: Cosmos EVM Flaw Exploited After Cosmos Labs Knew Every Blockchain Running It Was Vulnerable
stories.description: A critical Cosmos EVM balance flaw was exploited on six chains after Cosmos Labs confirmed all Cosmos EVM chains were affected.

stories.title: Attackers Chain Two PaperCut Flaws to Execute Code Without Authentication
stories.description: Attackers chain two PaperCut NG and MF flaws for unauthenticated remote code execution, with limited exploitation seen in two environments.

stories.title: Android 17 Adds OS-Wide ECH to Hide Website Visits From Network Providers
stories.description: Android 17 adds OS-wide ECH, local network permissions, default certificate transparency, and carrier-controlled 2G blocking.

stories.title: In Other News: Log4j RCE Scare, Minimus Shutdown, Iranian Hacker Sanctions
stories.description: Noteworthy stories that might have slipped under the radar: Manchester Airports Group cyberattack, Carhartt breach data was partly fake, U.S. Bank responds to ransomware gang’s claims.

stories.title: ATF Confirms Cyber Incident After Ransomware Group Claims Attack
stories.description: The Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives has described it as a ‘major incident’ and it’s conducting an investigation with the DOJ.

stories.title: OpenAI Agents Exploited Linux Kernel Flaw on Company’s Own Systems
stories.description: CISA has added the exploited flaw, CVE-2026-53362, to its KEV catalog, alongside a JFrog vulnerability exploited by OpenAI agents.

stories.title: Tech, Cybersecurity Giants Unite Behind OpenAI-Led Cyber Defense Pledge
stories.description: Nearly 130 tech and cybersecurity companies back a collective call to boost cyber defenses as AI-enabled attacks grow more sophisticated.

stories.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 400 Security Holes
stories.description: Microsoft today released updates to remedy at least 398 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and supported software, including one weakness that is already being actively exploited and two others that were publicly detailed prior to today.
